head query is honest lexical retrieval and is deliberately NOT
forbidden; the fixture instead requires the concept answer to lead
with concept_anchor evidence, so the curated naming passage always
outranks the surface coincidence. 'bema seat' has no lexical path at
all (the word is not in the WEB text) — pure measured gap.

(DOCTRINAL-BASIS §4); it locates the two passages that say 'judgment
seat of Christ' and the label is the text's own phrase. Matt 6:2-4
(Phillips's third in-corpus ref) is deliberately not asserted — it
does not name the judgment seat.
